src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: User record settings
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Sets how a user's record is stored, limiting the length of the language setting kept for each person.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Role assignment record settings
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Sets how the record of who holds which role is stored in the database.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Farm account lifecycle
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Groups the actions that rename, suspend and bring back a farm account, kept apart from sign-in details.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Access test setup
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Sets up the sign-in side of a fresh farm so a first account and its permissions exist.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Access lookup
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Looks up which farm and flocks a signed-in person may see, on every request, using only the current farm's records.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Accounts and sign-in hub
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Gathers the sign-in, accounts, first-run and token features into the single entry point the rest of the app uses.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Account setup actions
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Bundles the actions for creating accounts, first-run admin setup and admin recovery.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Starter data lookup
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Finds existing accounts and users while sample data is loaded so the same people are not created twice.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Account lockout
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Counts wrong passwords per person and locks the account after too many, for every place a password is checked.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: New farm accounts
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Creates a new farm account together with its first owner and starting settings.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Farm code change
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Changes a farm's short account code and records the change.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: User name rules
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Checks a new or changed user against the rules of their own farm, so the same name can exist on different farms.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Farm suspension
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Takes a farm account offline and brings it back, signing its people out when suspended.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Farm user directory
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: The one place that finds a user by name or email within a given farm account.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Admin emergency recovery
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Lets someone with server access regain control of an admin account by issuing a temporary password.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Role record
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: How a role such as owner or manager is stored in the database.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: User record
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: How a person who signs in is stored: their login, farm account, language and related settings.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in security log
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Writes the security log entries for failed sign-ins and account lockouts, whichever check caught them.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in freshness check
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Checks that a sign-in pass was issued after the person's last password or security change, so old passes stop working.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Password confirmation
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Checks a person's current password for extra-sensitive actions and password changes, counting wrong tries toward lockout.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Code re-check period
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Setting for how many days (30 by default) a person with two-step sign-in can stay signed in before being asked for their code again.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: First admin creation
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Creates the very first owner account on a new install and refuses to create a second one.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: First-run status
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Tells the sign-in screen whether the first owner exists yet, so a new install can point people to setup.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: acting session
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that protects two-step changes from races with password resets or disabling.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: turn off two-step
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that lets a person turn off their own two-step sign-in, or an owner reset someone else's.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in service core
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: The main sign-in service: checks passwords, handles lockouts and issues the sign-in passes.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: disable and enable users
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that disables and re-enables a person's account.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: email changes
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that handles changing and confirming a person's email address.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: set up two-step
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that lets a person set up or replace their authenticator app.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: sign out
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that signs people out and cancels their stay-signed-in passes.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: passwords
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that changes and resets passwords.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: stay signed in
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that swaps an old stay-signed-in pass for a fresh one and spots reuse of stolen ones.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: roles
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that changes who holds which role.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: code step
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that checks the code from a person's authenticator app or a recovery code.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: passes
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that creates and checks the sign-in passes handed to the app.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in: users
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Part of the sign-in service that creates, lists and updates the people who can sign in.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Extra-check pass tracker
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Describes the record that makes each extra-check approval single-use and cancels it on sign-out.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Two-step credentials contract
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Describes everything that stores and checks a person's authenticator key and recovery codes, and the possible results of a check.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in pass settings
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Settings for the sign-in passes, such as who issues them and how long they last.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.name: Sign-in pass maker
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Modules/Acc.description: Creates the signed short-lived pass the app carries to prove who is signed in.
